BiblicalUsage: The word is a government, an empire, and it appears twice, in the promise of the Child: the government shall be upon His shoulder, and of the increase of His government and peace there shall be no end.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the government on His shoulder is the only one that never fails: every empire ends, but His government increases and His peace has no end.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
